# Morgonkoll: Embracer rapporterar – slår förväntningarna

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-11-11  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a morning market briefing. Wall Street fell after US core inflation for October came in hotter than expected, and several Fed members said more rate hikes may be needed soon. Nvidia kept falling over the CEO-related scandal, Hims & Hers dropped 17% after a report miss and CoreWeave rose after hours on a guidance raise. At home, Embracer beat expectations with 20% organic growth, while New Wave improved its margins but had lower revenue than expected. Stockholm was expected to open higher.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 EMBRAC-B — Embracer | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Quarterly report beat expectations clearly: 20% organic growth vs. an expected decline; adjusted result of 307m vs. 257m.

#### Reasoning

This is a news item from the host, not a stated recommendation. The beat on both growth and earnings is a clear positive surprise that could move the stock in the short term. The signal is weak because no buy view was expressed.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the organic growth turns out to be one-off
- if the guidance disappoints in the CEO interview

> *"Spelutvecklaren Embracer klår analytikernas förväntningar. Den organiska försäljningstillväxten var hela 20 %."*

---

### 🟠 NEWA-B — New Wave | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Margin rose to 13.2% and EBIT improved by +100m, but revenue was below expectations.

#### Reasoning

This is mixed news from the host with no stated recommendation. Margins and profit improved, but the revenue miss could weigh on the stock in the short term.

#### Sell Triggers

- if revenue growth keeps falling short of expectations
- if the margin gains reverse

> *"Omsättningstillväxten var 10,2% men intäkterna var lägre än förväntat."*
